newsitem.title: USA: Healthsource's Payson to create foundation.
newsitem.headline: Healthsource's Payson to create foundation.

text.p: Healthsource Inc Chief Executive Norman Payson intends to use $94 million in proceeds from the sale of the health maintenance organization to CIGNA Corp to fund health care programs for New Hampshire residents who can't afford or find health insurance, spokesman Tracey Turner said Friday.
Payson and Cigna Corp announced a deal to sell Healthsource last week for a reported $1.7 billion. Payson founded the health insurance company with 100 Concord-area doctors in 1985.

Payson said the sale should yield him personally $94 million in cash and he wants the money to start a foundation. The New Hampshire Health and Human Services Department oversees millions of dollars in funds from a health care transition account to fund community health care programs.
HHS Commissioner Terry Morton praised Payson for his determination to create the foundation for health care access.
Payson expects to work out the details of the foundation over the next six months with state officials. The sale of Healthsource should be completed in three to four months, he said.
